review_examples.product: NIOD Fractionated Eye-Contour Concentrate 15ml
review_examples.review_text: This is hyaluronic acid which can be excellent for plumping your skin.... when you live in a humid climate. I couldn't figure out why my under eye area was getting more and more fine lines while using this product until I researched this. If the hyaluronic acid does not have moisture to pull from the air... it pulls it from your skin instead. I live in a desert climate, so this explains a lot. The solution is to apply it to wet skin and layer it with an occlusive agent. Also sleep with a cool mist humidifier in your room... or just purchase a different product that is not straight hyaluronic acid, but has it listed as one of the ingredients instead - not the only ingredient.

review_examples.review_title: Form but not function -- take a pass on this razor.
review_examples.review_text:
Be wary of this razor. It's a definite downgrade from previous Norelco razors in terms of function.

Pros:
- Looks cool
- Cleans easily
- Shaves stubble (and only stubble) close
- Can be returned to Norelco within 60 days for a full refund

Cons:
- Does not handle anything over stubble well for long. Has very shallow reservoirs for the hair to collect in and when you shave anything longer than stubble it gets gunked up and doesn't perform as well.
- Will spray hair everywhere if you tilt it off your face while running. This is a result of the shallow reservoirs. The hair seems to collect on top of the razor instead of inside it.

review_examples.review_title: Will not work with Optical Signals from Some TV brands
review_examples.review_text:
The original TVlink I did not have a optical input, so they added a crippled one to the Tvlink II. The issue is that virtually all modern TV sets output audio thru a optical connector and are set to Dolby Digital 5.1 by default. The Tvlink II will not respond to a optical signal with Dolby Digital. Why?? The Resound Reunite works fine with a Dolby Digital optical signal.

So, if your TV allows it, you can go into setup and muck around to change the audio decoding to PCM in order to make the TV link II work. review_examples.review_text:
This is a great product to keep the clipper blades lubricated and to kill the HIV virus.
I used it for years and years until I started reading product labels and trying to decipher what they actually mean. It turns out that

1) all disinfectants in the USA have to be tested by the AOAC methodology, and then registered with the EPA.

2) the EPA registers anti-bacterial disinfectants only as:
a) limited-efficacy disinfectants
b) general-purpose disinfectants
c) hospital-grade disinfectants
